_README: Template for the 13 external governance references on jurisdiction_care_policies/CA.
Copy this file, fill in the real values, then:
These are NOT runtime blockers. Childcare operates without them. They are
checked by evaluatePolicyReadiness, which only childcare/deployGate.ts (the
launch checklist) consults — so npm run childcare:deploy-plan will report
jurisdiction_incomplete until they are recorded. Both facts are true at once.
Do NOT put placeholder text in the approvals block. A reference ID that
asserts counsel or an insurer signed off, when they did not, is a false
compliance record — and it is precisely what someone would read back after
an incident. Leave a field out entirely rather than inventing it; the seeder
only writes keys you supply, and it rejects an approval that is present but
DELETE this _README key before use (or leave it — it is ignored).

legalCounsel._note: Counsel memo/opinion ID + firm + date. This is also the natural place to record the answer to the open question: does Evia's MATCHING engine make it a referral/placement service under CA law, and if so does TrustLine attach? UrbanSitter avoids TrustLine while explicitly disclaiming that it is a 'referral, matching or placement service' — Evia cannot make that same disclaimer.

insurance._note: Certificate number + insurer + issue date + EXPIRY. Readiness fails once expiresOn is in the past, so this one needs a renewal reminder. Note the incumbent carries none and pushes insurance onto users — carrying coverage is a differentiator, not a requirement.

jurisdictionScreeningProgram._note: FOUNDER DECISION 2026-07-28: TrustLine is NOT used. The approved CA screening program is the shared Checkr base package with annual renewal (same as senior care). Basis: HSC 1596.66 compels TrustLine only for license-exempt providers paid with public subsidy funds (Alternative Payment / CalWORKs / CCDBG), excepting grandparents/aunts/uncles — Evia is private-pay. Put the counsel memo ID recording that program here. REMAINING TRIGGER: if Evia ever accepts subsidy-funded families, TrustLine becomes mandatory for those caregivers (statutory condition on the funding source, not a preference).

consentVersions._note: Version identifiers for the PUBLISHED documents a user actually agreed to. Use the version string of the live document, not a date you picked.

incidentContacts.label: 24/7 childcare incident escalation
incidentContacts._note: Must be a number a human actually answers around the clock. This is the path a caregiver's 'she fell and hit her head' escalates to. An unanswered number here is worse than none, because the system will believe escalation succeeded.
